review.levelCheck: Arithmetic within 100 is available at this level; no Grade 3 mental-addition procedure is required.
review.methodDistinctness: One sufficient method is included without inventing separate mental and written methods from the same equations.
review.annotationCheck: cnm_p032 fits the two-digit-minus-one-digit subtraction step. Leaving assessedIds empty and proposing a route-neutral calculation node avoids unsupported equivalence with application modeling or a specified addition algorithm.
review.preservationCheck: The first method and compiledSolution preserve the current explanation byte-for-byte. The annotation changes have a concrete scope-based reason; the prose needs no repair.
review.provenanceCheck: The solution remains retained upstream translation with attribution, source revision, CC-BY-NC-4.0 and AI/translation qualifications preserved. The missing-node proposal and annotations are project contributions, not newly attributed solution prose.
